Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor [n25347] (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kw motor.
Our latest forecast for part:350011 grows +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
We commit to a binding volume of 6,110 pcs per year over 12 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €373.13 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
Please note:
We have verified your updated volume forecast and applied the corresponding economies of scale to our calculation.
In response to your offer of faster payment, we have adjusted the payment terms back to 30 days net to grant you a more advantageous price.
The requested cost breakdown will be provided by our technical department.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €369.02 per unit.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kw motor.
To substantiate our volume commitment: our official forecast fc:350011@2026-09 shows 6110 pcs per year, +11.9% against the previous plan. The attached forecast-plan.csv lists the monthly demand plan we release to our suppliers.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
We commit to a binding volume of 6,110 pcs per year over 12 months.
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We can accept your terms and await your order.
Our terms: a price of €361.28 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION.
Please note:
We have already taken that volume change data into account.
We welcome the inclusion of the CU-NOTATION index clause, which mitigates our material risk and enables a substantial reduction in the base price.
Please note that your volume forecast was already fully accounted for in our previous calculations.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
